title: Tool-Using Agent with Human Approval Gates
description: Build a stateful ReAct-style agent that plans, calls real tools, and pauses for explicit human approval before any irreversible or a risk-classified action, with a persisted state machine, trace log, and resumable runs recorded honestly.
learningObjectives: Implement a deterministic agent state machine with explicit transitions
Classify actions by risk tier and gate the risky ones
Persist agent state for resumability after crashes
Evaluate the agent with replayable traces rather than vibes

milestones.title: Persisted state machine
milestones.objective: Implement agent states (plan, act, await-approval, done) with journal; a killed process resumes exactly.
milestones.expectedOutput: Kill-and-resume test passes on a real run.

milestones.title: Risk-tiered tool surface
milestones.objective: With ≥3 tools with risk tiers; tier 2+ requires stored approval records before execution.
milestones.expectedOutput: Unapproved risky actions blocked with typed errors.

milestones.title: Reflective loop
milestones.objective: Add a self-reflection step that critiques failed plans and retries with revised reasoning.
milestones.expectedOutput: Trace shows a failed attempt followed by a successful revision.

milestones.title: Trace evaluation
milestones.objective: Define success criteria for at least 5 tasks; run them and report pass rate plus gate compliance.
milestones.expectedOutput: Task pass table from replayed traces.

criteria: State machine + resume semantics work properly

categories.excellentExpectation: Walkthrough of a gated action end-to-end

architecture: state store (journal) → planner → executor with gate check → reflection
risk classification as config, not code
hints: Make 'await_approval' a real durable state, not a sleep loop — resumes after restarts are the test
